notes.title: Minor Update April 10th, 2023
notes.content: I added a pop up to highlight some of the important mechanics to being a successful Dungeon Vendor. This was based on some early feedback the game has received. Once again, thank you for playing The Dungeon Vendor!

notes.title: Let's talk about Happiness!
notes.content:
[b]Happiness[/b] is the key to a good life, and a successful dungeon run! In the Dungeon Vendor, that happiness meter is the metric which shows you the heroes satisfaction with the potential quality and price of the weapon you are making. This is effected by the materials you choose and the cost of the weapon vs the amount they have. Adjust both to make the best weapon at the fairest price to make them happy.

[i]So who cares if the hero is happy?[/i] Well, the happier the hero the better the loot you will get in return if they survive. The better the loot the less you need to spend at the merchant, the more you can save for mid-late game materials. The success will snowball so don't sleep on that happiness meter!

Also, stop buying wood and rat hilt from the merchant! That's just the merchants way of trying to tell you that you got a bad roll!

Also also, the (?) on the top left is a valuable tool in every phase until you start to better understand the game so don't be afraid to use it.

Remember it's designed to be a very relaxing game so take your time and focus on HAPPINESS!

Thank you for adventuring with The Dungeon Vendor!

notes.title: Thank you!
notes.content: It's tough to get traction coming from no where, so thanks for giving us a chance. All feedback is welcome here, on our [url=https://discord.gg/qdwHVUve]Discord[/url], and on  [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/TheDungeonVendor/]Reddit[/url].

notes.title: The Dungeon Vendor Release
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that on Thursday, April 6th The Dungeon Vendor will be released. In preparation for that we have started up our [url=https://discord.gg/wz5ESP89rV]Discord[/url] and are looking forward to feedback on the game.

For me personally this has been a long pursuit, finally releasing my first game after teaching digital design and game design for over twenty years. I look forward to connecting with you all!
